description: Abstract base class for univariate statistics within the Apache Commons Math library. Provides default implementations for data handling, validation, and delegation to subclasses for specific evaluations.

classes.name: AbstractUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: Abstract class providing common functionality for univariate statistic implementations in Apache Commons Math. Handles data storage, validation, and evaluation delegation.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Stores a copy of the provided data array or clears data if null.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored data array.

methods.name: getDataRef
methods.description: Returns a reference to the stored data array.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Copies a portion of the input array into the stored data, with validation of indices.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic on the stored data or given array.

methods.name: evaluate (with parameters)
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic over a specified subarray.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the statistic object.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Validates input array indices and subarray length, throws exceptions if invalid.
